title: Multi-pane assemblies.
officialText:
Multi-pane glazed assemblies having individual panes not exceeding 1 square foot (0.09 square
meter) in exposed area shall have at least one pane in the assembly marked as indicated in Section 2406.3. Other panes in the
assembly shall be marked CPSC 16 CFR 120 1 or ANSI Z97.1, as appropriate.
